subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-discovery of agent configurations from external workspaces

question: Should OpenClaw support core trusted workspace-agent discovery, or keep agent registration explicit through existing config/RPC workflows?
rationale: The request adds new config, filesystem scanning, trust boundaries, precedence rules, and live routing semantics that cannot be chosen safely by automation.

options.title: Keep explicit registration
options.body: Continue using central config and `agents.create/update/delete`, and leave external discovery to docs, operator tooling, or plugins unless a smaller missing API is proven.

options.title: Design trusted discovery
options.body: Define trusted roots, file patterns, precedence, validation, conflict behavior, reload semantics, and security proof before implementation.

options.title: Improve zero-restart registration first
options.body: Extend explicit runtime agent registration and binding reload behavior before adding broad filesystem scanning.

recommendation.title: Keep explicit registration
recommendation.body: Continue using central config and `agents.create/update/delete`, and leave external discovery to docs, operator tooling, or plugins unless a smaller missing API is proven.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current-main source-history signal on both central files that would need product-direction review.
